title: Планы на компьютер (Промпт)
description: Скопируй промпт в чат с ИИ и обсуди планы. Станция засчитывается, когда ты реально поговорил.

promptCard.prompt: Ты — мой сверстник из англоговорящей страны. Мне ___ лет. Давай поговорим о планах. Отвечай на мои вопросы и задавай свои на эту тему. Используй Future Simple и be going to do smth. Исправь меня, если я ошибусь, но только в конце нашего диалога и в очень дружеской форме)

extra.title: Dialogue: “New Computer Plans”
lines: Alex: Hey, Jamie! What are you going to do with your old computer?
Jamie: Hi Alex! I'm going to buy a new one. My old computer is too slow for games. What about you?
Alex: I'm not sure yet. Maybe I'll ask my parents for a new keyboard.
Jamie: That's a good idea. Will you get a gaming keyboard with lights?
Alex: Yes, I think I'll get a blue one. It will look cool in my room.
Jamie: Nice! I'm going to install new games on my new computer. I'll play every day after school!
Alex: Don't forget about homework! Will you study first?
Jamie: Hmm… I'm going to try, but games are more interesting! What games will you play?
Alex: I'll probably play Roblox and Minecraft. They're always fun.
Jamie: Me too! I'm going to build a huge castle in Minecraft. You'll come and visit, OK?
Alex: Deal! I'll bring my new keyboard, and we'll play together.
Jamie: Awesome! It'll be the best gaming session ever!
